en: In this world, there are those with white wings, called angels,

jp: 黒い翼を持つ邪悪な者達がいる
en: and wicked ones with black wings, called demons.

jp: 白き翼を持つ天使達は、
黒き翼を持つ邪悪な悪魔達を倒し
人々の暮らしを守ってくれていた
en: The white-winged angels fought the black-winged demons and kept the people safe.

jp: 小さな島に住んでいるボク達は
en: But for us, living on a small island far from the mainland,
the war between angels and demons

jp: ボク達とは関わりのない
遠くの出来事だと思っていた・・
en: was something far away, nothing to do with us... or so we thought.
